description: This file defines a wrapper for the XNNPack delegate used in TensorFlow Lite's stable delegate testing framework. It exports a constant that represents the stable delegate in C API form, including versioning and plugin details.

methods.name: TfLiteVersion
methods.description: Returns the current version of TensorFlow Lite runtime.

methods.name: TfLiteXnnpackDelegatePluginCApi
methods.description: Provides the plugin configuration for the XNNPack delegate in C API form.
